# Original Player Motion

Two independent executions of the unchanged pinned LEZAC.EXE produced this
controlled projection of 6737..732C and its nested helpers.

- 7,028 cases; 24 execute the actual player CALL at 7F59.
- All 899 original instruction sites in the player interval, ammunition-cap
  helper and portal helper execute in the corpus.
- Complete memory and endpoint registers match observed versus unobserved runs.
  Ordered writes reconstruct all changed memory; original code bytes remain
  unchanged. No instructions are patched, calls stubbed or later states injected.
- The compact stream contains initial data/stack differences, register traces
  and ordered writes, not full RAM images.

This is controlled CPU-boundary evidence. The production App, a natural campaign,
an original IRQ schedule and full-frame pixel fidelity are not established.
The computed IRQ checks are separate C++ continuation controls.
Pickup-score overflow is covered for both players, including the carry path
identified by the compiled counterexample that escaped the earlier matrix.
